name: Sub Osc
author: Emilie Gillet
description: A shaped main oscillator against a square sub one or two octaves down, loudest at both ends of the sub control.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Morphs the main oscillator from a square to a variable saw.

controls.label: Width
controls.description: Sets pulse width, from symmetric down to a thin sliver.

controls.label: Sub level
controls.description: Adds the sub two octaves down below noon and one octave down above it, with none at noon.

controls.label: Sub width
controls.description: Narrows the sub oscillator's pulse below noon, leaving it square above.

outputs.main: The main oscillator blended with the sub.
outputs.aux: The sub oscillator alone, at full level.
